01 The Club

A practical place to train. Built around consistency.

IMTHI’S FITNESS CLUB is a fitness club in DHA Phase 2, Islamabad, set up for people who want to get on with their training. It’s a straightforward space: an open floor, a fenced training zone and machines laid out so you can work through a routine without fuss.

Whether you’re getting back into a routine or keeping one going, the idea is the same: show up, put in the work, repeat.

On the machine list

  • Chest press
  • Leg press
  • Butterfly
  • Seated row
  • Leg curl
  • Low row
  • Smith machine

As listed by the club on its Google profile. Ask us what’s currently on the floor.

02 Training

Train for strength, conditioning, fitness, and your own goals.

Come in with a plan, or build one as you go. What you work on is up to you.

  • 01

    Strength

    Build strength on a floor set up for resistance work, at a pace that suits you.

  • 02

    Conditioning

    Work on stamina and overall conditioning, so everyday effort starts to feel easier.

  • 03

    Cardio

    Keep your heart rate up for endurance and general fitness.

  • 04

    Consistency

    The routine you stick to beats the perfect one you don’t. Turn up, then do it again.

Classes, coaching and programmes aren’t listed on this page. Call or message the club to ask what’s currently on offer.
